title: Mixed Event — This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day — Episode2 The Lead-Up

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day
meta.Event Outline: Fresh second-years Minori and Shiho are on the animal caretaker committee, and their work has already begun. When they learn about a shadowing opportunity at Odaiba Animal Land from a teacher, they decide to participate. Animal antics ensue!

rows.Line: After school
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ...is what happened.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, Shiho and I are gonna be going to the zoo to shadow as zookeepers!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you and Shii?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No fair!
Taking care of animals at the zoo sounds like so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Have you already heard specifically what you'll be doing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They're gonna give us all the details when we get there... But I do know that we'll at least be cleaning where the animals live and feeding them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's wonderful!
I'd love to try feeding some large animals.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Large animals...?
Working with giraffes and elephants could be very fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... It's an indoor zoo, so I'm not sure they have any animals that big...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I did see on TV the other day that they have tapirs and emus there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, that's pretty cool!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You should make the most of this opportunity since you don't normally get many chances to directly interact with those kinds of animals.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I will! I'm super excited because Samo and the rabbits at school are the only animals that I usually get to interact with♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You said you'll be going the Saturday after next?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right!
Everything we had planned for that day got cancelled, so I decided to jump at the opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay... I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be looking forward to hearing how it went.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You won't just hear how it went. I'll even bring back souvenirs!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll definitely be looking forward to those!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Have fun, Minori!
Shadowing day
Odaiba Animal Land

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Okay, I believe everyone's here.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Thank you all again for coming to shadow with us today. I'll begin by explaining your schedule for today. I hope you're all ready to have a wonderful experience.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Thank you for having us!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I-I-I-It's really happening!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Calm down.
Also, I didn't realize so many students from other schools would be here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I bet this is really popular because you get to take care of real animals! I mean, how lucky are we?!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Alright, we've already assigned each school to a specific area of the zoo. Please turn to page two of your shadowing manuals.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, the names of all the schools are listed here...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
In alphabetical order!
Alright, Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy starts with an “M” so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Found it! We're in the “Grassland Area” with the shoebill and chipmunks!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Chipmunks...?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Today's program is split into two halves. For the first half, you'll be taking care of the animals in the areas you've been assigned to.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Then, you'll all take a break. After that, for the second half, we'll have you all come take a look at what happens behind the scenes. Depending on how things go, we may end a little early or a little late.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Cool...!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Now, you'll all be heading over to be with the animals soon, but let me explain a little more before you do.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Taking care of the animals will involve both feeding them and cleaning up after them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Feeding and cleaning...?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Before you feed them, you'll be measuring out a precise amount based on their prescribed diets.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Depending on the animal, you may need to cut slices of meat.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wow, that's pretty hands-on.
We really get to be zookeepers in that sense.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm guessing the chipmunks get nuts and berries...but what about the shoebills?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
They're big birds, so fish?
Then again, I've seen ostriches eat all sorts of things...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll find out soon.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Once you've prepared their food, you'll feed them yourselves and proceed to clean up their habitats. When you've finished, the first half of your day will end.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Food prep, feeding, cleaning...
They're having us do more than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, since just cleaning the rabbit cage always takes a pretty long time...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: That concludes this brief explanation of what you'll all be doing today.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: The caretakers at each of the areas will give you all further instructions. Please feel free to start making your way over now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, we finally get to take our first big step as animal caretakers...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hang on, chipmunks, shoebill! We'll be right over to give you all the love you need!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: W-Wait, if you shout like that...

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Hehe. That girl sure sounds excited.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Wait a minute. She looks really familiar for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: See? It might be a good idea to keep your voice down. What if people start figuring out who you are...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, good call...
Thanks for the heads up, Shiho!
